g.text: PWA/local web + local API + SQLite + anomaly
model + local RAG + optional local LLM
Web + API + SQLite + simulator; no local LLM
Do not make the judge's random laptop perform local model inference. Run ASTRA services from the team's
controlled demo machine and let the judge client be a browser. The team's own laptop should also be
capable of running the full offline profile for the network-disconnection demonstration.
